description: This file defines a 'Reporting' class with methods for generating test reports in various formats (JSON, XML, JUnit), processing logs, comparing metrics, and summarizing test results. It is part of a testing framework, likely for Zephyr OS, and handles detailed report generation and analysis.

classes.name: Reporting
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and managing test reports in various formats, processing logs, comparing metrics, and providing summaries of test results.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Reporting object with test plan and environment data, setting up instance variables and timestamp.

methods.name: process_log
methods.description: Reads a log file, filters out non-printable characters, and returns the cleaned string.

methods.name: xunit_testcase
methods.description: Creates a test case element in an XML test suite, updating statistics based on test status and logs.

methods.name: xunit_report_suites
methods.description: Generates a combined XML report of all test suites from a JSON results file.

methods.name: xunit_report
methods.description: Generates an XML report for selected platforms or all, based on JSON results, with options for full or summarized reports.

methods.name: json_report
methods.description: Creates a JSON report summarizing test instances, including environment info, test case details, and logs.

methods.name: compare_metrics
methods.description: Compares current test metrics against saved metrics, returning differences for analysis.

methods.name: footprint_reports
methods.description: Analyzes metric deltas and logs warnings if significant footprint changes are detected.

methods.name: synopsis
methods.description: Provides a summary of issues found during testing, with instructions for rerunning tests.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Summarizes overall test results, including pass/fail counts, errors, skipped tests, and warnings.

methods.name: save_reports
methods.description: Saves generated reports in JSON and XML formats, optionally for specific platforms.

methods.name: target_report
methods.description: Generates platform-specific XML and JSON reports.
